issues.explanation: The 'audit channel accepts writes' test ends with the tautology expect(true)->toBeTrue() instead of asserting a record was written, and it writes to the real storage/logs/audit.log as a test side effect.

buildText() (and the config() read) run before the try/catch, so an unexpected error while formatting context (for example a throwing __toString()/JsonSerializable) would escape send() and break the caller, conflicting with the 'never throw' requirement.
stringify() handles JsonSerializable and Stringable objects that the task's scalar/array context never needs; dropping those branches would keep the service smaller.
The nested-array redaction test only exercises sensitive keys, so a Bearer credential under a non-sensitive nested key is not covered.

review.summary: Adds App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert (silent no-op when unconfigured, JSON POST, key/Bearer redaction, 1800-character truncation, URL-scrubbed soft-fail logging), the audit daily channel, daily/stack env defaults, docs and Pest coverage. Requirements, security and documentation are met, so this is an approve-with-nits: the main nits are a tautological audit-channel assertion and context formatting placed outside the try/catch that is supposed to make send() never throw.
